k < count; ++k) {\n            vel[ib + k].x += DT * Fx[k];\n            vel[ib + k].y += DT * Fy[k];\n            vel[ib + k].z += DT * Fz[k];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t lo, size_t hi) {\n    for (size_t i = lo; Kinetic terms cover the owned bodies; pair terms\n// cover rows i = rank, rank + size, ... so the triangular pair loop is spread evenly.\ndouble partialEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, Range mine, int rank, int size) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (size_t i = mine.begin; i < mine.end; ++i) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (vel[i].x * vel[i].x +\n                         vel[i].y * vel[i].y +\n                         vel[i].z * vel[i].z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += size) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pos[i].x;\n            const double dy = pos[j].y - pos[i].y;\n            const double dz = pos[j].z - pos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(pos[i].x) || !std::isfinite(pos[i].y) || !std::isfinite(pos[i].z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(vel[i].x) || !std::isfinite(vel[i].y) || !std::isfinite(vel[i].z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(pos[i].x) > maxPos || std::abs(pos[i].y) > maxPos || std::abs(pos[i].z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(vel[i].x) > maxVel || std::abs(vel[i].y) > maxVel || std::abs(vel[i].z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (numBodies < 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Number of bodies must be non-negative\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(numBodies);\n    const Range mine = blockRange(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Every rank generates the same initial state, so no initial scatter is needed\n    std::vector<Body> init(n);\n    randomizeBodies(init);\n    std::vector<Vec3> pos(n), vel(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        pos[i] = init[i].pos;\n        vel[i] = init[i].vel;\n    }\n\n    // Per-rank counts and displacements in doubles (3 per body) for the position exchange\n    std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const Range range = blockRange(n, r, size);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(3 * (range.end - range.begin));\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(3 * range.begin);\n    }\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(pos, vel, mine.begin, mine.end);\n        integrateBodies(pos, vel, mine.begin, mine.end);\n        // Share the updated positions of owned bodies with all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, pos.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double end = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>((end - start) * 1000.0));\n    }\n\n    // Velocities are only held by their owner; gather them on rank 0 for output and validation\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            MPI_Gatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, vel.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Gatherv(vel.data() + mine.begin, counts[rank], MPI_DOUBLE, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && rank == 0) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n        bodyData.reserve(n * 6);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].z);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].z);\n        }\n        print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    if (validate) {\n        int ok = 1;\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n            ok = validateSimulation(pos, vel) ? 1 : 0;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&ok, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (ok) {\n            // Report final energy for reference\n            double localEnergy = partialEnergy(pos, vel, mine, rank, size);\n            double finalEnergy = 0.0;\n            MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &finalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int rc = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":3,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":["+#include <mpi.h>","+","+#include <algorithm>"," #include <chrono>"," #include <cmath>"," #include <cstdio>"]},{"oldStart":9,"oldLines":17,"newStart":12,"newLines":31,"lines":[" "," constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;"," constexpr double DT = 0.01;","+// Bodies processed together in the force kernel. step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(pos, vel, mine.begin, mine.end);\n        integrateBodies(pos, vel, mine.begin, mine.end);\n        // Share the updated positions of owned bodies with all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, pos.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double end = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>((end - start) * 1000.0));\n    }\n\n    // Velocities are only held by their owner; i < n; ++i) {\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].z);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].z);\n        }\n        print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    if (validate) {\n        int ok = 1;\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n            ok = validateSimulation(pos, vel) ? 1 : 0;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&ok, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (ok) {\n            // Report final energy for reference\n            double localEnergy = partialEnergy(pos, vel, mine, rank, size);\n            double finalEnergy = 0.0;\n            MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &finalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int rc = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":7,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":[" #include <mpi.h>"," "," #include <algorithm>","-#include <chrono>"," #include <cmath>"," #include <cstdio>"," #include <cstdlib>"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_018iq6XedJrdARRqrW5uSfTa","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Each lane keeps its own accumulator and\n// sums over j in the same order as the serial code, so results are bit-identical.\nconstexpr size_t FORCE_BLOCK = 8;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(Vec3) == 3 * sizeof(double), \"Vec3 must be tightly packed for MPI transfers\");\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\n// Half-open range [begin, end) of body indices owned by one rank\nstruct Range {\n    size_t begin;\n    size_t end;\n};\n\nRange blockRange(size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    return { n * rank / size, n * (rank + 1) / size };\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Updates velocities of bodies [lo, hi) using the positions of all bodies\nvoid computeForces(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t lo, size_t hi) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n\n    for (size_t ib = lo; ib < hi; ib += FORCE_BLOCK) {\n        const size_t count = std::min(FORCE_BLOCK, hi - ib);\n\n        double xi[FORCE_BLOCK], yi[FORCE_BLOCK], zi[FORCE_BLOCK];\n        double Fx[FORCE_BLOCK] = {}, Fy[FORCE_BLOCK] = {}, Fz[FORCE_BLOCK] = {};\n        // Lanes past the end of the block repeat the last body; their results are discarded\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < FORCE_BLOCK; ++k) {\n            const Vec3& p = pos[ib + std::min(k, count - 1)];\n            xi[k] = p.x;\n            yi[k] = p.y;\n            zi[k] = p.z;\n        }\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double xj = pos[j].x;\n            const double yj = pos[j].y;\n            const double zj = pos[j].z;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < FORCE_BLOCK; ++k) {\n                const double dx = xj - xi[k];\n                const double dy = yj - yi[k];\n                const double dz = zj - zi[k];\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx[k] += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy[k] += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz[k] += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            vel[ib + k].x += DT * Fx[k];\n            vel[ib + k].y += DT * Fy[k];\n            vel[ib + k].z += DT * Fz[k];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t lo, size_t hi) {\n    for (size_t i = lo; i < hi; ++i) {\n        pos[i].x += vel[i].x * DT;\n        pos[i].y += vel[i].y * DT;\n        pos[i].z += vel[i].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// This rank's share of the total energy. Kinetic terms cover the owned bodies; pair terms\n// cover rows i = rank, rank + size, ... so the triangular pair loop is spread evenly.\ndouble partialEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, Range mine, int rank, int size) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (size_t i = mine.begin; i < mine.end; ++i) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (vel[i].x * vel[i].x +\n                         vel[i].y * vel[i].y +\n                         vel[i].z * vel[i].z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += size) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pos[i].x;\n            const double dy = pos[j].y - pos[i].y;\n            const double dz = pos[j].z - pos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(pos[i].x) || !std::isfinite(pos[i].y) || !std::isfinite(pos[i].z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(vel[i].x) || !std::isfinite(vel[i].y) || !std::isfinite(vel[i].z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(pos[i].x) > maxPos || std::abs(pos[i].y) > maxPos || std::abs(pos[i].z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(vel[i].x) > maxVel || std::abs(vel[i].y) > maxVel || std::abs(vel[i].z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy Each lane keeps its own accumulator and\n// sums over j in the same order as the serial code, so results are bit-identical.\nconstexpr size_t FORCE_BLOCK = 8;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(Vec3) == 3 * sizeof(double), \"Vec3 must be tightly packed for MPI transfers\");\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\n// Half-open range [begin, end) of body indices owned by one rank\nstruct Range {\n    size_t begin;\n    size_t end;\n};\n\nRange blockRange(size_t n, int rank, int size) {\n    return { n * rank / size, n * (rank + 1) / size };\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Updates velocities of bodies [lo, hi) using the positions of all bodies.\n// The fused multiply-adds are written out explicitly so every build produces the same bits.\nvoid computeForces(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t lo, size_t hi) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n\n    for (size_t ib = lo; ib < hi; ib += FORCE_BLOCK) {\n        const size_t count = std::min(FORCE_BLOCK, hi - ib);\n\n        double xi[FORCE_BLOCK], yi[FORCE_BLOCK], zi[FORCE_BLOCK];\n        double Fx[FORCE_BLOCK] = {}, Fy[FORCE_BLOCK] = {}, Fz[FORCE_BLOCK] = {};\n        // Lanes past the end of the block repeat the last body; their results are discarded\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < FORCE_BLOCK; ++k) {\n            const Vec3& p = pos[ib + std::min(k, count - 1)];\n            xi[k] = p.x;\n            yi[k] = p.y;\n            zi[k] = p.z;\n        }\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double xj = pos[j].x;\n            const double yj = pos[j].y;\n            const double zj = pos[j].z;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < FORCE_BLOCK; ++k) {\n                const double dx = xj - xi[k];\n                const double dy = yj - yi[k];\n                const double dz = zj - zi[k];\n                const double distSqr = std::fma(dz, dz, std::fma(dx, dx, dy * dy)) + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx[k] = std::fma(dx, invDist3, Fx[k]);\n                Fy[k] = std::fma(dy, invDist3, Fy[k]);\n                Fz[k] = std::fma(dz, invDist3, Fz[k]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {\n            vel[ib + k].x += DT * Fx[k];\n            vel[ib + k].y += DT * Fy[k];\n            vel[ib + k].z += DT * Fz[k];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t lo, size_t hi) {\n    for (size_t i = lo; i < hi; ++i) {\n        pos[i].x += vel[i].x * DT;\n        pos[i].y += vel[i].y * DT;\n        pos[i].z += vel[i].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// This rank's share of the total energy. Kinetic terms cover the owned bodies; pair terms\n// cover rows i = rank, rank + size, ... so the triangular pair loop is spread evenly.\ndouble partialEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, Range mine, int rank, int size) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n    double energy = 0.0;\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (size_t i = mine.begin; i < mine.end; ++i) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (vel[i].x * vel[i].x +\n                         vel[i].y * vel[i].y +\n                         vel[i].z * vel[i].z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += size) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pos[i].x;\n            const double dy = pos[j].y - pos[i].y;\n            const double dz = pos[j].z - pos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(pos[i].x) || !std::isfinite(pos[i].y) || !std::isfinite(pos[i].z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(vel[i].x) || !std::isfinite(vel[i].y) || !std::isfinite(vel[i].z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(pos[i].x) > maxPos || std::abs(pos[i].y) > maxPos || std::abs(pos[i].z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(vel[i].x) > maxVel || std::abs(vel[i].y) > maxVel || std::abs(vel[i].z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (numBodies < 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) printf(\"Number of bodies must be non-negative\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    const size_t n = static_cast<size_t>(numBodies);\n    const Range mine = blockRange(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Every rank generates the same initial state, so no initial scatter is needed\n    std::vector<Body> init(n);\n    randomizeBodies(init);\n    std::vector<Vec3> pos(n), vel(n);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        pos[i] = init[i].pos;\n        vel[i] = init[i].vel;\n    }\n\n    // Per-rank counts and displacements in doubles (3 per body) for the position exchange\n    std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const Range range = blockRange(n, r, size);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(3 * (range.end - range.begin));\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(3 * range.begin);\n    }\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(pos, vel, mine.begin, mine.end);\n        integrateBodies(pos, vel, mine.begin, mine.end);\n        // Share the updated positions of owned bodies with all ranks\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, pos.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double end = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>((end - start) * 1000.0));\n    }\n\n    // Velocities are only held by their owner; gather them on rank 0 for output and validation\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            MPI_Gatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, vel.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Gatherv(vel.data() + mine.begin, counts[rank], MPI_DOUBLE, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && rank == 0) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n        bodyData.reserve(n * 6);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].z);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].z);\n        }\n        print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    if (validate) {\n        int ok = 1;\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n            ok = validateSimulation(pos, vel) ? 1 : 0;\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&ok, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (ok) {\n            // Report final energy for reference\n            double localEnergy = partialEnergy(pos, vel, mine, rank, size);\n            double finalEnergy = 0.0;\n            MPI_Reduce(&localEnergy, &finalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int rc = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":93,"oldLines":9,"newStart":93,"newLines":9,"lines":[" "," void integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t lo, size_t hi) {","     for (size_t i = lo; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfz6hv7PJUzQQgjX6Yqh4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The n-body benchmark now runs on MPI. `-r` hashes are bit-identical to the original serial build for every case I tested, from 1 to 16 ranks. Only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` changed. The executable is still `nbody`, and I created no new files in the repo.\n\n**How it's parallelized**\n- Each rank owns a contiguous block of bodies. Each step it computes forces and integrates only its own bodies, then `MPI_Allgatherv` shares the updated positions with all ranks. Velocities stay local until output, when they are gathered to rank 0.\n- Each body's force sum still runs over `j` in the original order, so results match the serial code exactly.\n- The force kernel processes 8 bodies at a time, so the compiler can vectorize across bodies without changing any per-body sum.\n- `-v` energy is computed in parallel and reduced to rank 0. Its partial sums are added in a different order, so the last bits can differ. This only affects the `%.6f` print, and the output matched in my test.\n- CMake uses `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. There is no optional path, so MPI is always used.\n\n**Choices I made that you may want to review**\n- The kernel writes out its fused multiply-adds with `std::fma` at the same points the original binary fuses them, and CMake adds `-ffp-contract=off`. Without this, the hash differed in the last bits from the original build. The results now don't depend on how the compiler chooses to contract.\n- I added `-fno-math-errno` so `sqrt` vectorizes. It doesn't change results.\n- A negative `-n` now prints an error and exits with code 1. The original crashed with an uncaught exception.\n- The timing uses `MPI_Wtime` and is measured across all ranks, so it is still reported in the same `Simulation time` line.\n\n**Verification**\n- I compared the `-r` hash and sample values against a reference build of the original code, for N = 0, 1, 2, 5, 7, 64, 257, 1023 and 1024 with various step counts, at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8 and 16 ranks. All matched.\n- `-v` output matches the serial build, `-h`, unknown options, and the default run behave as before.\n- The build is clean with `-Wall -Wextra`. I built out-of-tree in `/tmp` to keep the repo clean.\n- Timing at N=16384, 3 steps: 5970 ms for the original serial build, 1515 ms on one rank, then 757, 380 and 210 ms on 2, 4 and 8 ranks.\n\n**Not verified**\n- I only ran on one machine with oversubscribed `mpirun`. I did not test on a multi-node cluster, so network scaling is unmeasured. Each step's position exchange moves all N bodies to every rank, so communication will become the limit at large node counts.\n- `-march=native` is still set, so binaries should be built on each target machine type.\n\nI did not commit anything, because this directory is not a git repository."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":607,"cache_read_input_tokens":75970,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":607},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6d849738-cbbd-4c9c-977e-cfd1926c5208","uuid":"e658e0dc-24f7-48f1-ae4a-93f5c02a2639","timestamp":"2026-10-13T10:44:14.004Z","request_id":"req_011Cfz6hunnKhfT17ti8f3Km"}
